description.text: Course Overview: Information and Communication Engineering is a first-level discipline, with two second-level disciplines: Communication and Information System, and Signal and Information Processing. This major covers numerous high-tech fields such as wireless communication, multimedia and image processing, electromagnetic fields and microwaves, medical X-ray digital imaging, array signal processing and phase space wave propagation and imaging, as well as satellite mobile video.Training Objectives: To cultivate scientific research and engineering professionals in the field of information and communication engineering, as well as faculty members for higher education institutions. Students are required to have a solid foundation in signal theory and communication systems, possess systematic specialized knowledge and necessary experimental skills, be familiar with the scientific and technological development trends in their research fields, and master a foreign language.

duration.text: The Information and Communication Engineering at Xidian University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

requirements.text: 1: Applicants must not have aChinese nationality.2:Applicants must be physically and mentally healthy (free from infectious diseases and any physical or mental diseasethat would have impact on the normal study), and must abide by Chinese laws and regulations, as well as XidianUniversity's school rules and regulations, and respect China's social morals and customs.3:Applicants must be at least 18 years old.4:Language competency 1) lELTS score of 6.5 or above 2)TOEFLscore of 80 or above 3)Duolingo score of105 or above 4)Applicants with a previous degree taughtin English may be exempted from providingEnglish language test scores if theyprovide relevant proof.
